info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Investment Portfolio Withdraw-v2-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Withdrawal Management API allows users to facilitate the removal of withdrawal requests associated with investment portfolios. By using this API, financial institutions can manage customer requests efficiently and ensure accurate transaction processing. This functionality is essential for portfolio managers and customer service teams who need to handle withdrawal modifications or cancellations. With its streamlined processes, the API enhances user experience by providing real-time updates on withdrawal status.

delete.summary: Delete a withdrawal from the portfolio.
delete.description: This operation allows users to delete a specific withdrawal from their portfolio. Ensure that the withdrawal is no longer needed before performing this action as it may affect financial records.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required for withdrawing from a portfolio. It must contain the necessary information for processing the withdrawal request, such as the amount and any identifiers related to the portfolio.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRequest.description: The request body for the DELETE operation on a portfolio withdrawal.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.description: Response schema for the successful execution of a withdraw operation. It contains information about the operation's status and the audit details.
